change.summary: 组件库新增:FigureGrid、Rule。用法见 components.md。

summary:
The `FigureGrid` renders the four views as a 2×2 set filling the 9 content columns, all same width with right edges aligned — replacing the earlier `FigureStrip` workaround. `Rule` isn't used since this report has no per-product step chains to group. Program checks pass.

Page structure: 页头 → 结论 → 核心指标(4 个 `Stat`,问题总数在前)→ 色觉模拟(`FigureGrid` 四张对照图)→ 色差分析 → 对比度明细 → 调色板 → 问题清单 → 修复建议 → 下一步 → 背景信息。
